From us to you

Shipping.

Standard delivery

Orders typically arrive within 3–5 business days after dispatch. Complimentary standard shipping is available on orders over $75.

Express delivery

Express delivery is available at checkout. Tracking details are sent by email once your ritual is on its way.

Made with care

Returns.

We want every PIYA ritual to feel right. Unopened items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. For damaged or incorrect items, contact customer care with a photograph and order number.

Your information

Privacy.

We collect only the information needed to provide your order, improve your experience, and—when you choose—share PIYA news. Payment details are handled through secure payment providers and are not stored by this prototype.

The essentials

Terms.

Product information is provided for general skincare guidance and is not medical advice. Prices, availability, and promotions may change. By placing an order, you confirm that the delivery and payment information provided is accurate.
